ideas.pitch: A real-time civic issue reporter and auto-routing dashboard tailored for Nagpur municipal authorities.
ideas.title: NagpurNagrikCivicAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Smart Cities & Civic Innovation track with a working local interface that mirrors successful municipal dashboard wins.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered matching platform connecting local farmers having crop stubble with nearby biomass and paper recycling plants in Nagpur.
ideas.title: VidarbhaAgroWasteMapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the regional stubble-burning issue in Vidarbha, providing judges with a clear, measurable environmental impact and local relevance.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first health triage assistant for rural clinics around Nagpur offering local dialect symptom screening and vaccination tracking.
ideas.title: GraminSwasthyaAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven multilingual health agent patterns to address rural healthcare gaps in Maharashtra, which heavily resonates with local judging panels.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension and scanner that detects localized phishing campaigns and fraudulent WhatsApp financial scams targeting local small businesses.
ideas.title: PhishGuardNagpurSME
ideas.why_it_could_win: Attacks the Cyber Security track with an immediate, tangible product that small business owners in Nagpur can test live during the judging round.

ideas.pitch: An AI computer vision dashboard estimating carbon congestion penalties and vehicle density from Nagpur traffic camera feeds to aid green signal optimization.
ideas.title: NagpurTrafficCarbonAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with the AI & Emerging Technology track using a hard-to-ignore visual demo of live traffic analytics.
